name: Matrix Countdown Clock
author: Chuck Hergenroeder
description: Shows a live countdown to Christmas, New Year's Day or a date you choose on an LED matrix, scrolling in any direction or held in the center. The number and the text each have their own font, size and colour; under a day it switches to an HH:MM:SS timer or hours. Can also show the temperature and wind from your own WeatherFlow Tempest station, taking turns with the countdown.

privacy.summary: Draws a countdown on a matrix model on this player. It talks only to FPP on this device unless you point it at another player. With Weather on, it also listens for your Tempest weather station's broadcasts on the local network; it sends nothing to it.

sends.to: http://the FPP player you set as FPP Host (this device by default)
sends.what: requests for the list of overlay models and to turn the chosen model on and off
sends.why: to draw the countdown on a matrix attached to that player

systemChanges.what: runs a background program whenever FPP is running, which draws the countdown frames
its background program listens on 127.0.0.1:32330, reachable only from this device; FPP's web server passes requests to it
when Weather is turned on, it listens for UDP broadcasts on port 50222 (all interfaces, shared with other listeners) to read a Tempest weather station; nothing is sent
installs the Debian packages python3-pil (to draw frames) and fonts-dejavu-core (its default font) if they are missing; uninstall leaves them

privacy.other: Its API is served through FPP's web server, so anyone who can open this player's FPP pages can change its settings and turn its output on or off, the same as FPP itself. Its FPP commands (countdown on/off, set target) do the same from anything that can run FPP commands, including the scheduler, MQTT and other FPP players. It switches the overlay model you choose on and off and writes pixels into that model's overlay buffer. It writes an activity log (logs/plugin-fpp-matrixcountdown.log). Its settings (config/plugin.fpp-matrixcountdown.json) stay after uninstall.
